pairs.difference: An Architect designs how a building looks; a Civil Engineer makes sure it stands up and gets built.
A Teacher takes a class and checks homework; a Principal runs the whole school and handles discipline.
A News Anchor reads the news on TV in a suit; an RJ chats and plays songs on FM, heard but not seen.
A Photographer takes stills; a Videographer shoots video, like the wedding film.
An Accountant keeps a company's books and files taxes; a Banker works at a bank, handling loans and accounts.
A Barber cuts men's hair and shaves beards; a Makeup Artist does faces, mostly for brides and shoots.
A Police Officer is government, can arrest people and has a station; a Security Guard is private and guards one building or gate.
A Software Engineer builds apps and products; a Data Scientist analyses data and builds models.
A Singer performs songs with their voice; a DJ mixes and plays tracks from a console at parties.
A Detective solves crimes openly; a Spy works undercover for a country.
A Doctor diagnoses and prescribes; a Nurse cares for patients and gives the injections.
A Lawyer argues one side; a Judge decides the case.
A Chef cooks in the kitchen; a Waiter takes orders and serves at the table.
A Pilot flies the plane from the cockpit; an Air Hostess looks after passengers in the cabin.
A Plumber fixes pipes and leaks; an Electrician fixes wiring and switches.
A Carpenter works with wood; a Welder joins metal with sparks and a mask.
An Actor performs roles in films; a Model poses for photoshoots and walks the ramp.
A Farmer grows crops on land; a Fisherman catches fish at sea.
A Postman delivers letters for India Post; a Delivery Agent delivers app orders on a bike.
A Dentist treats people's teeth; a Vet treats animals.
A Soldier is in the Army, on land; a Sailor is in the Navy, at sea.
Both wear suits and oxygen tanks. An Astronaut goes to space; a Scuba Diver goes underwater.
Both rescue people. A Firefighter fights fires; a Lifeguard watches swimmers.
Both are at kids' birthday parties. A Magician does tricks; a Clown has a red nose and makes people laugh.
A Tailor stitches clothes; a Cobbler mends shoes.
A Driver drives the car; a Mechanic repairs it.
A Cricketer uses a bat and ball; a Footballer kicks a ball.
A YouTuber posts videos online; a Stand-up Comedian performs live on stage with a mic.
Both look after living things outdoors. A Gardener tends plants; a Zookeeper tends animals.
